metadata.description: RICO-style contradiction rules for statements within and across documents
metadata.source_paper: Detecting Contradictions Within and Across Documents (DocChecker)

rules.description: Same entity, materially different numeric values (revenue, temperature, date-as-number...)
Same entity with opposing polarities/claims (increase vs decrease, supports vs opposes)
Same entity in incompatible states (alive/dead, open/closed, married/single)
NLI cross-encoder judges the statement pair contradictory (unstructured fallback)
